neighbours.label: The predicate of an open condition: the verb inside an if-clause or a 'those who …' clause, strongest for wanting or continuing ('if you wish', 'if current trends continue', 'those who want to'); the same verb in a plain statement stays quiet
fire: If present trends continue, the lake will be dry within twenty years.
If you wish to change your password, click the link at the bottom of the page.
If members want to vote by post, they must register before Friday.
Those who wish to attend the dinner should reply by the end of the week.
If you are thinking of buying a used car, check the service history first.
If the weather stays fine, the match will go ahead as planned.
If prices keep rising, many families will struggle to pay their rent.
If we hope to finish on time, everyone must work this weekend.
quiet: Present trends continued, and the lake was dry within twenty years.
I changed my password yesterday using the link at the bottom of the page.
The members voted by post, having registered before Friday.
Sixty guests attended the dinner and most replied within the week.
She bought a used car last month after checking the service history.
The weather stayed fine, so the match went ahead as planned.
Prices kept rising, and many families struggled to pay their rent.
We finished on time because everyone worked that weekend.

notes: Card: Korean -다면, Japanese ため/ると, Arabic 'those who wish', English 'If managers wish'. Probes: 'If current sales continue' 0.56, 'If you wish' 0.31, 'If you are looking' 0.27, 'Anyone who wants' 0.24; 'I wish to cancel' 0.10, 'She wants to join' 0.01.
